The '''''Black Talon''''' was a [[Gage-class transport|''Gage''-class transport]] in service with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Revinal Orzik]].

==Characteristics==
Resembling the larger, more heavily armed [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class]] [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]], the ''Gage''-class transport traded the destroyer's numerous [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] banks for cargo space and troop barracks. Where the ''Gage''-class did resemble its cousin, however, was its heavy armor--the transport wasn't built for speed or combat, but to get its cargo to a destination intact.
The ''Black Talon'', like others of its class, had a wide and spaciously designed bridge.<ref name="DW" />

==History==
Sometime during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]] ordered the ''Black Talon's'' [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Revinal Orzik]] to intercept the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] ''[[Brentaal Star]]'', which carried a turncoat Imperial officer whom Kilran wanted silenced. When Orzik disobeyed the order as he considered it suicidal, Kilran dispatched a team of elite operatives to discipline him. Once proper control had been restored, the ship was brought out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] near the ''Brentaal Star'', which immediatelly opened fire on the ''Black Talon'' to provide cover for [[Boarding craft/Legends|boarding pods]] sent against the transport. The operatives, backed up by remaining Imperial marines successfully repelled the Republic boarding teams, in turn boarding the Republic warship and securing the target turncoat Imperial officer. The ''Black Talon'' escaped with all objectives swiftly and successfully completed, before [[Grand Master/Legends|Jedi Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]]'s inbound Republic reinforcement fleet arrived.

==Behind the scenes==
The mission undertaken aboard the ''Black Talon'' can be accomplished two ways chosen by the player. The dark side path has the player choose to execute the Captain. This elevates the [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]] to the rank of Captain, and the mission takes the player to repel Republic [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and soldiers that were dropped off by boarding pods. The light side path sees the player sparing the captain and takes the player to the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] to fight off enemies that are being dropped off by [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle]]s. Either way, the players repel the invaders, board the Republic Warship, and either kill or capture the turncoat Imperial officer.
